title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 152 ]

blocks.text: A child will often ask for approval openly. "Look at my painting! Isn't it pretty?" But adults are generally less honest about their need for support. A grown-up who tried his or her best at something isn't like to ask, "Didn't I do a good job!" But the adult needs to hear it all the same. In other words, children and adults alike want to hear positive remarks. Therefore, don't forget to praise others when they need support.

readingSentences.english: A child will often ask for approval openly.
readingSentences.korean: 아이는 종종 공개적으로 승인을 요청하는 경향이 있다.

readingSentences.english: Isn't it pretty?" But adults are generally less honest about their need for support.
readingSentences.korean: 예쁘지 않아요?" 그러나 어른들은 지지를 받고 싶은 욕구에 대해 일반적으로 (아이들보다) 덜 솔직하다.

readingSentences.english: A grown-up who tried his or her best at something isn't like to ask, "Didn't I do a good job!" But the adult needs to hear it all the same.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 일에 최선을 다한 어떤 어른이 "내가 일을 잘 하지 않았나요?" 라는 질문을 할 것 같지는 않다. 그러나 그는 그럼에도 불구하고 그 말을 들을 필요가 있다.

readingSentences.english: In other words, children and adults alike want to hear positive remarks.
readingSentences.korean: 즉, 아이들과 어른들 똑같이 긍정적인 말을 듣기 원한다.

readingSentences.english: Therefore, don't forget to praise others when they need support.
readingSentences.korean: 그러므로 다른 사람들이 지원을 필요로 할 때 그들을 칭찬하는 것을 잊지 말아라.
